sources.title: Yunnan Nationalities Museum, Kunming - Yunnan Exploration
sources.content:
Yunnan Nationalities Museum - Complete Information

Overview
The Yunnan Nationalities Museum sits on the east bank of Dianchi Lake adjacent to Yunnan Nationalities Village in Kunming. "Completed in 1995, it is a comprehensive ethnology museum" spanning over 200 acres with 130,000 square meters of building space. The institution houses collections showcasing "the ecological environment, religious customs, culture and arts and ethnic relics of the ethnic groups of Yunnan."

Collections & Structure
The museum maintains "over 20,000" items representing 17 ethnic nationalities. Its staff includes 23 assistant research fellows and 28 lecturers across five departments: Administration, Exhibition, Cultural Relics, Research, and Scientific Education.

Main Exhibitions

Ethnic Costumes and Processing Skills - Displays traditional garments, cloth types including "Dai brocade and Zhuang brocade," spinning wheels, looms, tie-dye techniques, and decorative ornaments.

Ethnic Writing and Ancient Books - Features primitive recording methods, ethnic ancient texts, inscriptions, and research achievements documenting various recording types.

Traditional Production and Life Skills - Showcases collecting, fishing, hunting, agriculture practices, dwelling architecture, daily utensils, pottery-making, paper processing, and food preparation methods.

Visitor Information
Admission: Free since January 1, 2011. Individual visitors must present valid ID; groups should call ahead.
Hours & Contact: Phone appointments at (0871) 4311385
Location: 1503 Dianchi Road, accessible by buses A1, A9, 44, 73, 24, and 135
Policies: Photography requires prior consent; no pets, smoking, or touching exhibits permitted.
Amenities: Bookstore, handicraft shop, tea house, artist studios, multi-function conference hall with interpretation systems.

sources.title: Yunnan Nationalities Museum - Wikipedia
sources.content:
Yunnan Nationalities Museum

The Yunnan Nationalities Museum is a museum in Kunming, Yunnan, China, dedicated to the cultural heritage of Yunnan's ethnic minority groups. It is the largest museum of its kind in China.

The museum was established in 1995 and is located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, near the Yunnan Nationalities Village. It covers an area of over 200 mu with a building area of 130,000 square meters.

The museum houses more than 40,000 sets of cultural relics, including the most complete collection of ethnic costumes and accessories in China. Its exhibitions cover ethnic clothing, ancient books, traditional technologies, musical instruments, folk masks, fine arts, and pottery.

The museum has been designated as a national patriotic education base and serves as a teaching and research base for nearly 40 universities and schools across China.

sources.title: Yunnan Nationalities Museum | Wonders of Yunnan Travel
sources.content:
Yunnan Nationalities Museum

The Yunnan Nationalities Museum is located next to the Yunnan Nationalities Village on the shores of Dianchi Lake in Kunming. It is the largest ethnology museum in China.

The museum showcases the diverse cultures of Yunnan's 25 ethnic minority groups through comprehensive exhibitions covering traditional costumes, musical instruments, religious artifacts, ancient texts, and daily life implements.

Visitors can explore eight thematic exhibition halls covering topics from ethnic social development to traditional crafts and festivals. The museum offers free admission and is recommended for visitors interested in understanding Yunnan's rich ethnic diversity.

Recommended visit duration: 2-3 hours. The museum pairs well with a visit to the adjacent Yunnan Nationalities Village for a full day of cultural immersion.

sources.title: Yunnan Nationalities Museum - Tripadvisor
sources.content:
Yunnan Nationalities Museum, Kunming

Located on Dianchi Road near the Yunnan Ethnic Village, the Yunnan Nationalities Museum is a comprehensive museum dedicated to the ethnic minorities of Yunnan Province. The museum is free to enter and houses extensive collections of ethnic costumes, artifacts, musical instruments, and cultural items.

Visitors recommend spending at least 2 hours exploring the multiple exhibition halls. The museum provides good context for understanding the diverse ethnic groups in Yunnan before traveling to more remote areas of the province.

sources.title: 云南民族博物馆 - 百度百科
sources.content:
云南民族博物馆 - 完整信息总结

基本信息
云南民族博物馆位于昆明海埂云南民族村旁，距昆明市区约9公里。竣工时间1995年11月9日，设有16个展厅。

规模与藏品
该馆占地面积13万平方米，建筑面积6万平方米。"展出的各类展品达万余件"，馆内藏品达12万件，珍藏民族文物40000余套（件）。截至2023年，拥有全部藏品22010件（套），陈列展览23个，年参观量为76.50万人次。

成立背景
1955年周恩来总理视察昆明后，指示要深入民族地区调查征集，研究少数民族社会经济形态。云南民族博物馆作为云南省"八五"重点建设项目，经过十余年筹建后正式开馆。

建筑特色
这是"中国最大的民族类博物馆，国际一级博物馆"。馆区分为展示区、收藏区和科研办公区，设有8个专题11个展厅。

主要展览（8个专题）
1. 云南少数民族社会形态——改革与发展
2. 云南少数民族生态产业
3. 云南少数民族纺织工艺和服饰艺术
4. 云南少数民族民间美术
5. 云南少数民族节庆乐舞
6. 云南少数民族手工艺品
7. 云南少数民族古籍文献
8. 奇石珍宝

馆藏精品
傣族槟榔盒：大龙竹刻花制品
壮族百楔鼓：打击乐器
瑶族采摘刀：采集专用工具
纳西族东巴经：民间土纸竹笔书写的经书
彝族木瓢吞口：虎头状面具

教育基地
被授予"全国青少年教育基地""云南省未成年人思想道德建设示范基地""爱国主义教育基地""科普教育基地"，是近40所全国大中小学的教学实习基地。

交通信息
地址：昆明海埂滇池路1503号
公交：A1路

所获荣誉
2025年3月：入选文化和旅游部、国家文物局国有公益性收藏单位名单（第一批）
2025年5月：入选第十批20世纪建筑遗产推介名录
